1.source_text: Previous to our coming to these valleys, I wished and prayed, that when we went to the valleys, there would not any of the wicked persons follow us, who are eternally hanging on our skirts. These arc my feelings and desires now, and the earnest wishes of hundreds and thousands of men and women who dwell in these valleys.

3.source_text: "The last time I ever saw him he related to me the following vision which he had in his field in open day: *I was carried away in a vision and found myself in the midst of a vast orchard of fruit trees. I became hungry and wandered through this vast orchard searching for fruit to eat, but I found none. While I stood in amazement finding no fruit in the midst of so many trees, they began to fall…

Previous to our coming to these valleys, I wished and prayed, that when we went to the valleys, there would not any of the wicked persons follow us, who are eternally hanging on our skirts. These arc my feelings and desires now, and the earnest wishes of hundreds and thousands of men and women who dwell in these valleys.

4.source_text:
He received me with a hearty welcome, and with that frank and
kind manner so universal with him in after years.
